transcript:
MARTIN: 	Hello?

DAVID 	(over phone, and will be heard like this throughout): 'Bout time you picked up.

MARTIN 	(not over phone): Hey David, you there already?

DAVID: 	Yeah, just pulled up.

SFX: CAR PULLING UP

MARTIN:	How's it look?

DAVID: 	Dilapidated, man. Not a whole lot to look at from the outside. Just a big, run-down building.

MARTIN: 	Hey, call my cell. I don't have the recorders hooked up to my landline.

DAVID: 	Alright.

[SFX: DAVID HANGS UP. WE HEAR MARTIN HANG UP HIS LANDLINE PHONE. THEN WE HEAR  MARTIN'S CELL PHONE RING. MARTIN PICKS IT UP]

MARTIN: 	Hey.

DAVID: 	Yo. You got a good signal?

MARTIN:	I hear ya loud and clear. Ready?

DAVID: 	Yeah, man, let's do it.

MARTIN: 	Well I got the plans laid out in front of me... Ready when you are... 

[SFX, ON MARTIN'S SIDE, THRU COMPUTER SPEAKER. A MU-HA-HA-HA OR WILHELM SCREAM]

DAVID: Oh you didn't say you had family over?

MARTIN: It's an email. And you're funny. You nearly there?

DAVID: Still heading down the path. Give me a minute.
